lines.zh: 我在温水珊瑚间甩尾，搅起一圈沙。
lines.en: I flick my tail between warm corals and stir up sand.

lines.zh: 繁茂洞穴的水潭里，我贴着苔藓游。
lines.en: In a lush cave pool I swim close to the moss.

lines.zh: 沙滩外缘的浅水，我一摆尾就溜走。
lines.en: In the shallows off the beach, one flick and I am gone.

lines.zh: 红褐色的鳞在暖流里闪了一下。
lines.en: My russet scales flash once in the warm current.

lines.zh: 我沿着珊瑚礁边缘巡游，绕了三圈。
lines.en: I patrol the reef edge three times around.

lines.zh: 泥泞的沼泽水里，我游得比泥还慢。
lines.en: In muddy swamp water I move slower than the mud.

lines.zh: 热带岛屿的浪推着我往前挪。
lines.en: Waves from the tropical island push me along.

lines.zh: 我钻进海草缝里，只留尾巴在外面。
lines.en: I slip into the seagrass, leaving only my tail out.

lines.zh: 温水漫过鳃盖，我张嘴吞了一口。
lines.en: Warm water washes my gill covers; I gulp once.

lines.zh: 我逆着暖流摆尾，身体却几乎没动。
lines.en: I beat against the warm current and barely move.

lines.zh: 沙地变种在浅滩上翻出一小团浑水。
lines.en: The sandy variant kicks up a small cloud of silt.

lines.zh: 珊瑚块越多，我游得越起劲。
lines.en: The more coral blocks, the harder I swim.

lines.zh: 我从繁茂洞穴的藤蔓下穿过去。
lines.en: I slip under the hanging vines of the lush cave.

lines.zh: 夜里珊瑚礁上方的水更暖。
lines.en: The water above the reef is warmer at night.

lines.zh: 我钻进珊瑚缝，只露半个尾巴。
lines.en: I duck into a coral crack, half a tail out.

lines.zh: 暖流推着我，我懒得摆尾。
lines.en: The warm current carries me; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我悬在温水里，鳍像扇子慢慢开合。
lines.en: I hang in warm water, fins opening like fans.

lines.zh: 一动不动时，我看起来像块花斑石头。
lines.en: Holding still, I look like a mottled stone.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的触手擦过我的侧腹。
lines.en: Coral tentacles brush along my flank.

lines.zh: 我把嘴凑到苔藓上，什么也没咬。
lines.en: I press my mouth to the moss and bite nothing.

lines.zh: 暖流推着我，我懒得多划一下。
lines.en: The current carries me; I am too lazy to paddle.

lines.zh: 赤褐色鳞片在暗处几乎看不出来。
lines.en: My russet scales nearly vanish in the dark.

lines.zh: 我停在沉下的珊瑚枝旁喘水。
lines.en: I rest by a sunken coral branch, gulping water.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥水让我身上挂了层绿。
lines.en: Swamp water has left a green film on me.

lines.zh: 洞穴水潭映着藤蔓的影子，我盯着看。
lines.en: The cave pool mirrors vine shadows; I stare at them.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，让暖水冲过鳃。
lines.en: I turn sideways and let warm water wash my gills.

lines.zh: 花纹在光里分成一块一块的。
lines.en: My pattern breaks into patches where the light falls.

lines.zh: 我吐出一个泡，看它浮到水面破掉。
lines.en: I blow a bubble and watch it rise and burst.

lines.zh: 潮水退了一点，我跟着往下沉。
lines.en: The tide drops a little; I sink with it.

lines.zh: 沙粒落在我背上，我懒得抖。
lines.en: Sand settles on my back; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把身体贴在暖石上不动。
lines.en: I press against a warm stone and stay still.

lines.zh: 我张合着嘴，慢慢换水。
lines.en: I open and close my mouth, slowly changing water.

lines.zh: 你踩进浅水，我停住尾鳍看你。
lines.en: You step into the shallows; I stop my tail and watch.

lines.zh: 我在珊瑚后面探出半张脸。
lines.en: I show half my face from behind the coral.

lines.zh: 隔着水面，你的影子落在我身上。
lines.en: Through the surface your shadow falls across me.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来时，我往前凑了一寸。
lines.en: When you crouch, I edge forward an inch.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看你的靴子搅浑水。
lines.en: I tilt my head as your boots muddy the water.

lines.zh: 你的手伸进水里，我先看手指。
lines.en: Your hand enters the water; I watch the fingers first.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转半圈，又退回去。
lines.en: I circle half around you, then retreat.

lines.zh: 暖海的光在你背后，我看不清。
lines.en: Warm-sea light is behind you; I cannot see clearly.

lines.zh: 我盯着你腰间的鱼竿。
lines.en: I stare at the fishing rod at your waist.

lines.zh: 我把头探出水面，鳃盖一张一合。
lines.en: I poke my head out, gill covers opening and closing.

lines.zh: 鳞被划开，水立刻灌进伤口。
lines.en: My scales split and water floods the wound.

lines.zh: 我猛地一摆尾，钻进珊瑚缝里。
lines.en: One hard tailbeat and I dive into a coral gap.

lines.zh: 疼得我翻了个身，又正过来。
lines.en: The pain rolls me over; I right myself.

lines.zh: 血丝在水里拉成一条线。
lines.en: A thread of blood stretches through the water.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底逃，鳍拖着走。
lines.en: I flee along the sand, fins dragging.

lines.zh: 被击中的地方，鳞掉了一片。
lines.en: A patch of scales is gone where it struck.

lines.zh: 我在水里乱撞，撞到了礁石。
lines.en: I thrash blindly and strike the reef.

lines.zh: 我缩进洞穴的暗处，不再动。
lines.en: I shrink into the cave dark and stop moving.

lines.zh: 伤口让我的游姿歪向一边。
lines.en: The wound tilts my swimming to one side.

lines.zh: 我张嘴喘水，鳃盖抖得厉害。
lines.en: I gape for water, gill covers trembling.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼食一落水，我就冲过去。
lines.en: The moment your bait hits the water, I rush over.

lines.zh: 温水里飘来的味道让我绕圈。
lines.en: A scent drifting through the warm water makes me circle.

lines.zh: 我不靠近岸，只在浅水跟着你走。
lines.en: I keep off the shore and follow you through the shallows.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎饵，被我一口气吞了。
lines.en: The crushed bait you scatter disappears in one gulp.

lines.zh: 珊瑚味混着饵味，我分不清哪个好。
lines.en: Coral and bait smells mix; I cannot tell which is better.

lines.zh: 我追着你的影子游到沙滩边。
lines.en: I chase your shadow all the way to the beach.

lines.zh: 你把网放下，我反而退了半米。
lines.en: You set down a net, and I back off half a metre.

lines.zh: 我闻到了海草，不是你要的那种。
lines.en: I smell seagrass, not the kind you brought.

lines.zh: 饵在水面打转，我盯着它转。
lines.en: The bait spins on the surface; I spin with it.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的脚边游，等下一把。
lines.en: I swim by your feet, waiting for the next handful.

lines.zh: 我一撞就滑开，鳞上留下水痕。
lines.en: I slide off on impact, a water trail on my scales.

lines.zh: 你踩到我，我甩尾溅你一身。
lines.en: You step on me and I splash you with my tail.

lines.zh: 我的身体又滑又凉，从你腿边擦过。
lines.en: Slick and cold, I brush past your legs.

lines.zh: 被碰到时，我的鳍全竖了起来。
lines.en: At a touch, every fin stands up.

lines.zh: 我撞在珊瑚上，掉了一小片碎屑。
lines.en: I hit the coral and knock loose a few fragments.

lines.zh: 你推我一下，我顺势翻了半圈。
lines.en: One push from you and I roll half a turn.

lines.zh: 水被搅浑，我在泥里找方向。
lines.en: The water clouds; I search for direction in the silt.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拍到你，比看上去有力。
lines.en: My tail hits you harder than it looks.

lines.zh: 贴着石头挤过去，我蹭掉一层苔。
lines.en: Squeezing past the rock, I scrape off a layer of moss.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我弹开半尺远。
lines.en: One touch and I dart half a foot away.

lines.zh: 两条狂摆鱼并排摆尾，水纹对上了。
lines.en: Two wildsplashes beat side by side, ripples matching.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，鳞色亮了一层。
lines.en: I circle it and my scales brighten a shade.

lines.zh: 我们把卵藏在珊瑚块之间。
lines.en: We tuck our eggs between the coral blocks.

lines.zh: 赤褐和花斑的鱼凑到了一起。
lines.en: The russet one and the calico one have come together.

lines.zh: 暖流里，我们贴着侧腹游。
lines.en: In the warm current we swim flank to flank.

lines.zh: 它摆尾，我也摆尾，节奏一样。
lines.en: It flicks its tail; I flick mine at the same beat.

lines.zh: 沙地上留下两行浅浅的沟。
lines.en: Two shallow grooves are left in the sand.

lines.zh: 泥泞里的那条花纹更深一些。
lines.en: The one from the mud carries a darker pattern.

lines.zh: 我们一起钻进海草，谁也没出来。
lines.en: We slip into the seagrass together and neither comes out.

lines.zh: 夜里的珊瑚礁，成对的影子贴着游。
lines.en: At night on the reef, paired shadows swim close.

lines.zh: 我没有手，掉落的东西只能沉下去。
lines.en: I have no hands; whatever drops must sink.

lines.zh: 你丢在水里的东西，我用嘴碰了碰。
lines.en: I nudge with my mouth what you dropped in the water.

lines.zh: 一只海草掉下来，我把它顶回水面。
lines.en: A seagrass piece falls; I push it back toward the surface.

lines.zh: 我叼着碎珊瑚，又吐了出来。
lines.en: I carry a coral shard, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 生鱼的味道在水里散开，我绕着转。
lines.en: Raw fish scent spreads; I swim circles around it.

lines.zh: 有东西沉底，我贴着沙找它。
lines.en: Something settles; I search the sand for it.

lines.zh: 我用嘴翻动石子，下面什么也没有。
lines.en: I nudge the pebbles aside and find nothing beneath.

lines.zh: 你放在浅滩的物品，被浪冲歪了。
lines.en: The waves tip over what you left on the shallows.

lines.zh: 我把浮起的小东西顶上岸。
lines.en: I butt a floating scrap up onto the shore.

lines.zh: 捞起来又滑掉，我试了三次。
lines.en: It slips from me three times before I give up.

lines.zh: 水里的动静一乱，我就转向那边。
lines.en: When the water stirs wrong, I turn that way.

lines.zh: 你踩水的频率变了，我盯住你。
lines.en: Your splashing changes rhythm; I fix on you.

lines.zh: 附近有鱼在跳，我立刻摆尾过去。
lines.en: A fish jumps nearby; I flick my tail toward it.

lines.zh: 我锁定了浅滩边那团晃动的影子。
lines.en: I lock onto the shifting shadow at the shallows.

lines.zh: 有东西受伤流血，味道先到。
lines.en: Something is bleeding; the smell arrives first.

lines.zh: 我绕开珊瑚，直接朝你游。
lines.en: I cut around the coral and swim straight at you.

lines.zh: 目标在礁石后面，我贴着边逼近。
lines.en: The target is behind the rock; I close along its edge.

lines.zh: 我选中了最小、最慢的那个。
lines.en: I pick the smallest, slowest one.

lines.zh: 水花一响，我的鳍就张开了。
lines.en: At the splash, my fins flare open.

lines.zh: 我在两步外停住，先看它动不动。
lines.en: I stop two paces away and see if it moves.

lines.zh: 我跟着你沿岸线游，不快也不慢。
lines.en: I follow your line along the shore, neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 你绕到珊瑚后，我从另一侧出来。
lines.en: You go behind the coral; I come out the other side.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底追，鳍扫起细沙。
lines.en: I chase near the bottom, fins sweeping up sand.

lines.zh: 你往上浮，我就跟着抬起身。
lines.en: You rise, and I lift with you.

lines.zh: 圈越收越紧，水也越来越浑。
lines.en: The circle tightens and the water thickens.

lines.zh: 我一直在你侧后方，没有超过去。
lines.en: I stay at your flank and never overtake.

lines.zh: 尾巴一拍，我又逼近了半尺。
lines.en: One tailbeat and I close another half foot.

lines.zh: 你换气的时候，我正好在你下方。
lines.en: When you surface for air, I am right below you.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的影子走，不碰礁石。
lines.en: I track your shadow without touching the reef.

lines.zh: 追到浅水，我的背鳍露出水面。
lines.en: In the shallows my dorsal fin breaks the surface.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在脚踝上，然后甩头。
lines.en: I bite your ankle and wrench my head away.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽过去，水花炸开一片。
lines.en: My tail lashes out and throws up a sheet of spray.

lines.zh: 我用整个身体撞，鳞都翻起来了。
lines.en: I ram with my whole body, scales flaring.

lines.zh: 咬住不放，我在水里打转。
lines.en: I hold on and spin through the water.

lines.zh: 牙齿细而密，撕不开就磨。
lines.en: My teeth are fine and crowded; I grind when I cannot tear.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，我更急了。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water and I grow frantic.

lines.zh: 我连着撞了三下，最后一下带牙。
lines.en: Three charges, and the last one comes with teeth.

lines.zh: 你退到岸上，我只能拍水。
lines.en: You back onto land; all I can do is thrash.

lines.zh: 鳍划破水面，我翻过来咬。
lines.en: Fins cutting the surface, I roll over to bite.

lines.zh: 力气用尽，我沉下去又冲上来。
lines.en: Spent, I sink and then surge up again.

lines.zh: 我生在温暖的浅海，第一口是海水。
lines.en: Born in warm shallows, my first mouthful is seawater.

lines.zh: 珊瑚块够多的时候，我才出现在这里。
lines.en: I only appear here where sixteen coral blocks crowd.

lines.zh: 夜里，我从礁石的缝里游出来。
lines.en: At night I swim out of a crack in the reef.

lines.zh: 繁茂洞穴的水潭里多了一条小鱼。
lines.en: One more small fish in the lush cave pool.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥水里，我破开一层浮萍。
lines.en: In the swamp mud I break through a skin of duckweed.

lines.zh: 沙滩外的浪把我推到浅处。
lines.en: The surf beyond the beach pushes me shallow.

lines.zh: 我从热带岛屿的礁盘边冒出来。
lines.en: I surface at the reef flat of a tropical island.

lines.zh: 一开始我只有拇指长，鳞还没色。
lines.en: At first I am thumb-length, scales still colourless.

lines.zh: 暖流把我带到这片珊瑚上方。
lines.en: A warm current carries me over this coral.

lines.zh: 我顺着洞穴的水道，一路游进来。
lines.en: I follow the cave channel and swim all the way in.

lines.zh: 水被烧热，我拼命往下潜。
lines.en: The water burns hot; I dive as deep as I can.

lines.zh: 我被抛到岸上，鳞贴着沙挣。
lines.en: Thrown onto the beach, I scrape my scales against sand.

lines.zh: 离开水太久，我的鳃黏在一起。
lines.en: Too long out of water, my gills stick together.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀出水面，又砸回礁石。
lines.en: The blast lifts me clear of the water and slams me onto the reef.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过水，钉在我尾鳍上。
lines.en: An arrow cuts through the water and pins my tail fin.

lines.zh: 药水的光让我的鳞发烫。
lines.en: Potion light makes my scales burn.

lines.zh: 三天没咬到东西，我游得发飘。
lines.en: Three days without a bite and my swimming goes loose.

lines.zh: 雷打进浅海，我整个人麻了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shallows and numbs me through.

lines.zh: 水底裂开，我掉进没有水的黑里。
lines.en: The seabed breaks and I fall into waterless dark.
